sources.label: PD 1096 RIRR 2004, Rule XVIII — Escalator and Moving Walk Requirements
sources.description: Governs escalator and moving walk design, installation, and safety requirements in Philippine buildings.

sources.label: ASME A17.1/CSA B44 — Safety Code for Elevators and Escalators
sources.description: International standard referenced for escalator dimensional requirements: minimum width (600mm), step depth, rise, and angle (30° max).

sources.label: BP 344 — Accessibility Requirements for Vertical Transportation
sources.description: Specifies accessibility dimensional requirements for escalators and moving walks serving the public.
